total_supply.meaning: ERC-20 totalSupply of HypoVault shares, including the 1,000,000 ghost shares never minted to any account

sum_balances.meaning: sum of balanceOf[] over all accounts, i.e. shares actually minted to holders

ghost_shares.meaning: 1,000,000 shares included in totalSupply but never minted to any account

formulas_scale_by_total_supply.meaning: both key share-minting and redemption formulas use totalSupply as a scaling factor

deposit_overmints_occurred.meaning: a deposit minted more shares to the new entrant than their fair pro-rata allocation, diluting incumbents

assumptions: The 1,000,000 ghost shares are treated as the literal constructor-included amount, not an illustrative figure.
Share-minting and redemption formulas scale by totalSupply, so an inflated totalSupply changes pro-rata allocation.
No attacker transaction sequence is required; the flaw is a constructor-time state condition.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the 1,000,000 ghost shares are a literal constructor argument value or an illustrative figure.
No concrete numeric expected-versus-actual share amounts are given for the over-mint effect.

limitations: The over-mint magnitude is not numerically specified; the impact is carried as a grounded Boolean occurrence symbol.
The correspondence relation totalSupply == sum(balanceOf[]) is the report's stated invariant; the deposit over-mint is the failure of fair pro-rata allocation under that invariant.
